items.title: 52222_Marshall Royal oral history interview
items.q: numbers that was done with C.P. Johnson's band

ctx.x: Back to Cee Pee C.P. Johnson. I was thinking about your quote from "Poor Butterfly" that you mentioned as one of the numbers that was done with C.P. Johnson's band and you mentioned the lyric line, "That chick was high, like a big fat butterfly," and I remember hearing it some years later, in what? 1949, and the Treniers were using that line and probably that arrangement.
Well, the Treniers (PHONETIC) weren't even in existence at that time.
